STRUCTURE in one viewport:
1) slim status bar9:41. Compact header with "叁序" atleft bold26dp, a small red THREE-STROKE brandmark beside the name; label"福彩3D" modest gray inline, settings icon right48dp.
2) A large calm white result region, NOT a floating giant bordered card: row "第2026263期" left and "09月30日" right, then a dominant horizontal triplet of solid red flat circles containing white digits9 8 7, three circles64dp each. 3) Compact gray-neutral horizontal trial row: "试机号" left, black monospaced "643" incenter, small "2026264期" under/alongside, refreshiconright. Distinct visual treatment prevents confusion with red formal result.
4) "最近开奖" section heading and "全部 →" right. Only real concise functional Chinese labels. Avoid all irrelevant sales figures, temperature/omission paragraphs, promotional messages. At the bottom above navigation, a clean fixed white task bar: left "合计 ¥8" with "1倍" inline stepper, right a red "加入方案" button.
